author: Jason Stys
summary: Preview validated DAG structure, inspect coherent job/event snapshots and review bounded unmet-parent, retry and lease evidence. Added real PostgreSQL API/worker execution and static-site delivery checks.
rationale: Turns workflow state into actionable diagnosis while keeping planning read-only. Inspection reports omit payloads, results and lease tokens; deployment still supplies a trusted identity/network/TLS boundary.
limitations: Trusted reference control plane; authentication, authorization, tenant separation and TLS are deployment responsibilities, not provided hosted services.
Workers execute only bounded delay, SHA-256 checksum and uppercase operations; this is not a general remote command runner.
Dependency waves are structural, not duration, concurrency or fairness forecasts. Captured countdowns are not live and do not reap leases.
Inspection omits payloads, results and lease tokens, but other existing endpoints expose job results; inspection redaction is not access control.

visualReview.method: Every rendered page individually viewed at readable original resolution

scope: Reviewed documentation editions of the cited source. Checksums identify bytes, not authorship. Historical measurements retain their own dates; integration CI must be checked separately.
